In a fixed robotic workspace, a rigid and physically consistent embodied robotic arm with high stability and no deformation proceeds to Sort laundry and personal care products from the blue rectangular bin to the lighter blue rectangular tray using the left gripper.

# PixelWorld generation contract v2

- Save intermediate generated results in the workspace when producing candidates for inspection. Choose whether and how to check or revise your output.
